description: DWSIM 10.2.12.0, Peng-Robinson: entropy and enthalpy of pure components and of C1/C2 and C1-C5 mixtures at 298.15 K and 1.01325 bar, formation terms excluded (relative to ideal gas at Tref, Pref).

conditions.units: S in kJ/(kmol K), H in kJ/kmol

binary_sweep_methane_ethane.source: raw DWSIM values, listed in the session

methane_ethane_50_50.note: also a point of the binary sweep

methane_ethane_90_10.note: also a point of the binary sweep

notes: The 50/50 and 90/10 methane/ethane cases are points of the binary sweep, so they were used to choose the rule and are not independent validations.
thermo-sim runs use a database without formation terms (hf = gf = 0, n_gas_el = 1) so that S and H are relative to the reference state.
